findings.claim: The diff adds a new module, frontend/src/components/FileHeaderRowProvider.tsx, which the touch-point list does not name.
findings.impact: This module carries the change's core behaviour: the stack of drawers that decides which page owns the row (flow 4, I1), the portal that keeps the row's controls in the page's React tree (I9), clean-up on unmount (I4), rowNeeds/hideHeaderControls (D7, I6) and trail alignment (D2, I2). A reviewer who scopes the work by the touch-point list would not read it, although a fault in it is what the user would hit (the header stuck in the file form, or briefly showing its ordinary form during a swap).
findings.evidence: frontend/src/components/FileHeaderRowProvider.tsx:1-184 (new file). AppShell.tsx:25 wraps the shell in it; Header.tsx:13, ChromeButtons.tsx:9, FileDetailChrome.tsx:16, FileDetailFullScreen.tsx:8 and RightPaneFile.tsx:9 import from it. The touch-point list names Header.tsx and AppShell.tsx as gaining 'a place a file page draws into', but not this file. invariants.md has an empty Revisions section, so the list was never amended.
findings.repro: Compare the diff's file list with the Touch points section of docs/specs/file-detail-single-header.md: FileHeaderRowProvider.tsx appears in the diff and is absent from the list.

bucket_proposal.reason: This is a scope gap in the declared touch points, not a broken invariant. The invariants that depend on the module (I1, I2, I4, I6, I9) are observed through the listed components and their tests.

findings.proposed_fix: Add frontend/src/components/FileHeaderRowProvider.tsx to the touch-point list (as a revision in invariants.md), so the drawer stack, the portal and the alignment logic are reviewed as part of the change.
